verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts docs say any signal can be evaluated against a threshold or for abnormal behavior. NRQL-based alerts are described as the primary and most powerful type, and notifications route issues to the correct system or team and define who is notified and how. The evidence never mentions grouping alerts into incidents or silencing/muting notifications. Missing for 10: documented alert grouping/correlation, documented silencing/muting rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
